rationale: The agent correctly verified identity (name + zip matched a single user), retrieved the delivered order, and asked for explicit confirmation before making changes. However, it made two critical errors: (1) It stated that a white, low-brightness, battery-powered desk lamp variant was available, but the product data shows no such variant. (2) After the user confirmed exchanging to the white, low, battery lamp, the agent executed the exchange to a silver, low, battery variant (item_id 7453605304) without notifying the user of the color change or obtaining explicit confirmation for that exact variant. The final confirmation message also inaccurately reported that the exchange was for a white lamp. This violates the requirement to confirm the exact change before any write and to avoid unsupported claims. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
